---
title: "Deck Viewer"
format:
  dashboard:
    scrolling: true
    include-before-body:
        text: |
            <style>
            #quarto-dashboard-header {
                display: none !important;
            }

            /* Full-width dashboard */
            .quarto-dashboard #quarto-content,
            .quarto-dashboard .quarto-dashboard-content,
            .quarto-dashboard .bslib-page-dashboard {
                width: 100% !important;
                max-width: none !important;
                padding-top: 0 !important;
                margin-top: 0 !important;
                padding-left: 0 !important;
                padding-right: 0 !important;
                align-items: start !important;
            }

            /* Full-width dashboard rows/cards */
            .quarto-dashboard .dashboard-row {
                width: 100% !important;
                max-width: none !important;
                align-items: start !important;
                grid-auto-rows: max-content !important;
            }

            .quarto-dashboard .dashboard-row > .card {
                width: 100% !important;
                max-width: none !important;
                height: auto !important;
                min-height: 0 !important;
                align-self: start !important;
            }

            .quarto-dashboard .dashboard-row > .card > .card-body {
                width: 100% !important;
                max-width: none !important;
                height: auto !important;
                min-height: 0 !important;
                box-sizing: border-box !important;
            }

            /* CMC grid uses the full card width */
            .cmc-grid {
                width: 100% !important;
                max-width: none !important;
                display: grid;
                grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(150px, 1fr));
                gap: 14px;
                align-items: start;
                height: auto !important;
                min-height: 0 !important;
            }

            .cmc-grid > div {
                width: 100%;
                min-width: 0;
                height: auto !important;
                min-height: 0 !important;
            }

            .cmc-col-head {
                font-size: 12px;
                font-weight: 600;
                opacity: 0.7;
                text-transform: uppercase;
                letter-spacing: 0.04em;
                margin-bottom: 6px;
            }

            /* Card stack */
            .card-stack {
                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                gap: 0;
                height: auto !important;
                min-height: 0 !important;
            }

            .card-stack img {
                width: 75%;
                border-radius: 4.75% / 3.5%;
                display: block;
                margin-top: -90%;
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
                box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
                transition: transform 0.12s ease, box-shadow 0.12s ease;
                position: relative;
            }

            .card-stack img:first-child {
                margin-top: 0;
            }

            .card-stack img:hover {
                transform: scale(1.1);
                box-shadow: 0 6px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);
                z-index: 20;
            }
            /* Compact horizontal stats card */
            .stat-grid {
                display: grid;
                grid-template-columns: repeat(11, minmax(0, 1fr));
                gap: 8px;
                width: 100%;
                align-items: center;
                font-size: 13px;
                margin: 0;
            }

            .stat-item {
                min-width: 0;
                text-align: center;
                line-height: 1.15;
            }

            .stat-label {
                opacity: 0.65;
                font-size: 11px;
                white-space: nowrap;
                margin: 0 0 2px 0;
            }

            .stat-value {
                font-weight: 600;
                font-size: 13px;
                white-space: nowrap;
                overflow: hidden;
                text-overflow: ellipsis;
            }

            /* Remove unnecessary vertical space around the stats */
            .quarto-dashboard .stat-grid {
                padding: 0;
            }

            .quarto-dashboard .dashboard-row > .card:has(.stat-grid) {
                min-height: 0 !important;
                height: auto !important;
            }

            .quarto-dashboard .dashboard-row > .card:has(.stat-grid) > .card-body {
                padding-top: 8px !important;
                padding-bottom: 8px !important;
            }
            </style>
engine: jupyter
execute:
  echo: false
---

## {.toolbar }

```{python}
#| output: false
#| echo: false

import sys, os

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "..")))
from src.backend.backend_functions import *

initialize_data()

CACHE_PATH = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "card_metadata.csv")
if not os.path.exists(CACHE_PATH):
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"{CACHE_PATH} not found. Run:  python -m src.backend.card_images"
    )

card_meta = pd.read_csv(CACHE_PATH)

# Prefer a locally mirrored image when --download-images was used; otherwise
# hotlink the Scryfall CDN. Falls back per-card, so a partial mirror still works.
if "local_path" in card_meta.columns:
    local = card_meta["local_path"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
    card_meta["image_src"] = local.where(local != "", card_meta["image_url"])
else:
    card_meta["image_src"] = card_meta["image_url"]

card_meta = card_meta[
    ["card_name", "cmc", "is_creature", "is_land", "image_src"]
].drop_duplicates(subset="card_name")
card_meta["cmc"] = card_meta["cmc"].fillna(0).astype(float)
for col in ["is_creature", "is_land"]:
    card_meta[col] = card_meta[col].astype(bool)

decks = get_vintage_decks()
standings = get_vintage_standings()

# One row per (deck, card). Metadata is joined client-side off card_name so
# this table stays narrow -- ~45 rows per deck instead of a full card record.
deck_cards = (
    decks[
        ["deck_id", "draft_id", "player_id", "card_name"]
    ]
    .dropna(subset=["card_name"])
    .astype({
        "deck_id": str,
        "draft_id": str,
        "player_id": str,
    })
    .drop_duplicates(
        subset=["deck_id", "draft_id", "card_name"]
    )
)
deck_cards = deck_cards.astype({"deck_id": str, "draft_id": str, "player_id": str})

# One row per deck, with the metadata the stats panel needs.
deck_index = decks.drop_duplicates(subset=["deck_id", "draft_id"]).copy()
deck_index = add_season_draft_labels(deck_index)

points = standings[["draft_id", "player", "match_points", "standing"]].copy()
points["draft_id"] = points["draft_id"].astype(str)
points["player"] = points["player"].astype(str)
deck_index["draft_id"] = deck_index["draft_id"].astype(str)
deck_index["player"] = deck_index["player"].astype(str)
deck_index = deck_index.merge(points, on=["draft_id", "player"], how="left")

# Average CMC excludes lands, matching calculate_stats() in the Dash version.
nonland_names = set(card_meta.loc[~card_meta["is_land"], "card_name"])
creature_names = set(card_meta.loc[card_meta["is_creature"], "card_name"])
cmc_lookup = dict(zip(card_meta["card_name"], card_meta["cmc"]))

summary = []

for (deck_id, draft_id), grp in decks.groupby(["deck_id", "draft_id"]):

    names = (
        grp["card_name"]
        .dropna()
        .astype(str)
        .drop_duplicates()
        .tolist()
    )

    nonlands = [n for n in names if n in nonland_names]
    creatures = [n for n in nonlands if n in creature_names]

    summary.append({
        "deck_id": str(deck_id),
        "draft_id": str(draft_id),
        "avg_cmc": (
            sum(cmc_lookup.get(n, 0) for n in nonlands) / len(nonlands)
        ) if nonlands else 0.0,
        "n_creatures": len(creatures),
        "n_noncreatures": len(nonlands) - len(creatures),
        "n_lands": len(names) - len(nonlands),
    })

deck_index = deck_index.astype({"deck_id": str, "draft_id": str, "player_id": str})
deck_index = deck_index.merge(pd.DataFrame(summary), on=["deck_id", "draft_id"], how="left")

DECK_COLS = [
    "deck_id", "draft_id", "player_id", "player", "season_draft_label",
    "archetype", "decktype", "deck_color_short", "match_points", "standing",
    "avg_cmc", "n_creatures", "n_noncreatures", "n_lands",
]
for col in DECK_COLS:
    if col not in deck_index.columns:
        deck_index[col] = None
deck_index = deck_index[DECK_COLS].sort_values(
    ["player", "draft_id"], ascending=[True, False]
)
deck_index["player"] = deck_index["player"].astype(str)

# Derived from deck_index, not get_vintage_players(): a player can only appear
# in the dropdown if they actually have decks, so an empty deck list is
# impossible. Matching on name also sidesteps player_id dtype drift between
# standings (int) and drafted_decks (float -> "7" vs "7.0" after astype(str)).
players = pd.DataFrame(
    {"player": sorted(deck_index["player"].dropna().unique())}
)

print(f"{len(players)} players, {len(deck_index)} decks, {len(deck_cards)} deck-card rows")

ojs_define(
    players=players,
    deck_index=deck_index,
    deck_cards=deck_cards,
    card_meta=card_meta,
)
```

```{ojs}

selectedDeck = deckByKey.get(deckPick)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
selectedCards = {
  if (!selectedDeck) return [];

  const seen = new Set();

  return deckCardsData
    .filter(d =>
      d.deck_id === selectedDeck.deck_id &&
      d.draft_id === selectedDeck.draft_id
    )
    .map(d => cardByName.get(d.card_name))
    .filter(d => {
      if (!d || seen.has(d.card_name)) return false;
      seen.add(d.card_name);
      return true;
    })
    .sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.card_name, b.card_name));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Same bucketing as group_cards_by_cmc(): 0-4 then everything 5+ together.
CMC_KEYS = ["0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5+"]

bucket = c => c.cmc >= 5 ? "5+" : String(Math.trunc(c.cmc || 0))

cardGrid = cards => {
  const root = document.createElement("div");
  root.className = "cmc-grid";

  if (!cards.length) {
    root.innerHTML = `<p class="text-muted">No cards.</p>`;
    return root;
  }

  const groups = d3.group(cards, bucket);

  for (const k of CMC_KEYS) {
    const group = groups.get(k);
    if (!group) continue;

    const column = document.createElement("div");

    const header = document.createElement("div");
    header.className = "cmc-col-head";
    header.textContent = `CMC ${k} · ${group.length}`;

    const stack = document.createElement("div");
    stack.className = "card-stack";

    for (const c of group) {
      const img = document.createElement("img");

      img.src = c.image_src;
      img.alt = c.card_name;
      img.title = c.card_name;
      img.loading = "lazy";

      stack.appendChild(img);
    }

    column.appendChild(header);
    column.appendChild(stack);
    root.appendChild(column);
  }

  return root;
};
```
